displayName: Gemini Enterprise Quality, Safety and Token Usage from Logs

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT engine_id
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.logMetadata.name), r'/engines/([^/]+)'),
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.engine_id),
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.engine), r'/engines/([^/]+)'),
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.servingConfig), r'/engines/([^/]+)')
  ) AS engine_id
  FROM `@__project_id.global._Default._Default`
  WHERE log_id IN ('discoveryengine.googleapis.com/gemini_enterprise_user_activity', 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details')
    AND resource.type IN ('consumed_api', 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/Agent')
)
WHERE engine_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY engine_id
LIMIT 1000

SELECT DISTINCT user_key
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.userIamPrincipal), '<elided>'),
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.userPseudoId),
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userInfo.userId)
  ) AS user_key
  FROM `@__project_id.global._Default._Default`
  WHERE log_id = 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/gemini_enterprise_user_activity' AND resource.type IN ('consumed_api', 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/Agent')
)
WHERE user_key IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY user_key
LIMIT 1000

text.content:
## Gemini Enterprise Quality, Safety and Token Usage from Logs

Answer outcomes, user feedback, grounding sources, Model Armor results, model token consumption and
Discovery Engine API errors, built with Log Analytics SQL from the
`discoveryengine.googleapis.com/gemini_enterprise_user_activity`, `gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details`
and `api_errors` logs ([setup guide](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/set-up-usage-audit-logs)).

* Prerequisites: **Enable instrumentation of OpenTelemetry traces and logs** for each app
  ([observability settings](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/manage-observability-settings)) and [Log Analytics on the `_Default` bucket](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/buckets#upgrade-bucket).
  Feedback comments, prompts and identities require **Enable logging of prompt inputs and response outputs**.
* Select a time range of at least one day. Use the **app** and **user** variables to focus on one app or user.

WITH ua_all AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    json_payload AS payload,
    resource.type AS resource_type,
    COALESCE(
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.logMetadata.methodName), r'([A-Za-z]+)$'),
      JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method)
    ) AS method,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.logMetadata.serviceName), r'([A-Za-z]+Service)$') AS service,
    COALESCE(
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.logMetadata.name), r'/engines/([^/]+)'),
      JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.engine_id),
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.engine), r'/engines/([^/]+)'),
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.servingConfig), r'/engines/([^/]+)')
    ) AS engine_id,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.userIamPrincipal) AS principal,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.userIamPrincipal), '<elided>'),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.userPseudoId),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userInfo.userId)
    ) AS user_key,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.answer.state) AS answer_state,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.answer.name), r'/sessions/([^/]+)') AS session_id,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.dataSourceInfo.selectionMode) AS selection_mode,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.modelInfo.model) AS model,
    CASE
      WHEN JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.agentInfo.coreAssistant) = 'true' THEN 'core_assistant'
      WHEN NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.agentInfo.displayName), '<elided>') IS NOT NULL
        THEN JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.agentInfo.displayName)
      ELSE REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.agentInfo.agent), r'/agents/([^/]+)')
    END AS agent,
    COALESCE(
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.query.text),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.query.parts[0].text),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.query),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.searchInfo.searchQuery)
    ) AS query_text,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.eventType) AS event_type,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.agentspaceInfo.agentspacePageType) AS page_type,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.agentspaceInfo.agentInfo.name) AS page_agent_name,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.feedback.feedbackType) AS feedback_type,
    COALESCE(
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.sanitizationResult.sanitizationVerdict),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.sanitizationResult.sanitizationVerdict)
    ) AS sanitization_verdict,
    COALESCE(
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.sanitizationResult.filterMatchState),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.sanitizationResult.filterMatchState)
    ) AS filter_match_state,
    COALESCE(
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.sanitizationResult.invocationResult),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.sanitizationResult.invocationResult)
    ) AS invocation_result,
    COALESCE(
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.response.sanitizationResult.sanitizationVerdictReason),
      JSON_VALUE(json_payload.sanitizationResult.sanitizationVerdictReason)
    ) AS sanitization_reason,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status.code) AS status_code,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status.message) AS status_message,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(1)
      FROM UNNEST(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY(json_payload.response.answer.replies)) AS reply,
           UNNEST(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY(reply.groundedContent.textGroundingMetadata.references)) AS ref
    ) AS reference_count,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.request.userEvent.userInfo.userAgent) AS user_agent
  FROM `@__project_id.global._Default._Default`
  WHERE log_id = 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/gemini_enterprise_user_activity' AND resource.type IN ('consumed_api', 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/Agent')
),
ua AS (
  SELECT * FROM ua_all
  WHERE IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(@app) = 0, TRUE, engine_id IN UNNEST(@app))
    AND IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(@user) = 0, TRUE, user_key IN UNNEST(@user))

          COUNT(1) AS turns

),

)
        SELECT

          IFNULL(agent_name, '') AS agent_name,

          ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(output_tokens), COUNT(1)), 0) AS avg_output_per_inference,
          ROUND(100 * SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cached_input_tokens), SUM(input_tokens)), 1) AS cache_hit_pct,

),

)
        SELECT

          IFNULL(engine_id, '(unknown)') AS app,
          COUNT(1) AS calls,

sectionHeader.subtitle: Discovery Engine API errors (ingestion, connectors, agent registry) and failed assistant turns

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql:
WITH err AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) AS method,
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.service) AS service,
    http_request.status AS http_status,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status.code) AS rpc_code,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.message) AS message,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.message), r'/dataStores/([^/ ]+)') AS data_store
  FROM `@__project_id.global._Default._Default`
  WHERE log_id = 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/api_errors' AND resource.type = 'consumed_api'
)
        SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, HOUR) AS hour, method, COUNT(1) AS errors
        FROM err
        GROUP BY 1, 2

WITH err AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) AS method,
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.service) AS service,
    http_request.status AS http_status,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status.code) AS rpc_code,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.message) AS message,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.message), r'/dataStores/([^/ ]+)') AS data_store
  FROM `@__project_id.global._Default._Default`
  WHERE log_id = 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/api_errors' AND resource.type = 'consumed_api'
)
        SELECT CONCAT('HTTP ', CAST(IFNULL(http_status, 0) AS STRING), ' / rpc ', IFNULL(rpc_code, '?')) AS status, COUNT(1) AS errors
        FROM err
        GROUP BY 1

widget.title: API errors by method and status

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql:
WITH err AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.method) AS method,
    JSON_VALUE(resource.labels.service) AS service,
    http_request.status AS http_status,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status.code) AS rpc_code,
    JSON_VALUE(json_payload.message) AS message,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.message), r'/dataStores/([^/ ]+)') AS data_store
  FROM `@__project_id.global._Default._Default`
  WHERE log_id = 'discoveryengine.googleapis.com/api_errors' AND resource.type = 'consumed_api'
)
        SELECT
          method,
          service,
          http_status,
          rpc_code,
          COUNT(1) AS errors,
          COUNT(DISTINCT data_store) AS data_stores,
          SUBSTR(ANY_VALUE(message), 1, 240) AS sample_message,
          MIN(timestamp) AS first_seen,
          MAX(timestamp) AS last_seen
        FROM err
        GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
        ORDER BY errors DESC
        LIMIT 50
